result.summary: Found 3 issues: a major layout problem with cut-off content at the screen edge, a minor content truncation issue, and a minor inconsistency in card styling.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccolo' restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section is cut off at the right edge of the screen, showing only a partial image and truncated name.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the horizontal scroll container padding or card width so cards are either fully visible or clearly indicate scrollability with a partial preview intentionally designed.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccolo' appears truncated as 'Trattoria Piccol' due to the card being cut off at the screen edge.
issues.suggestion: Ensure text truncation uses ellipsis styling consistently or adjust card width to prevent mid-word cuts.

issues.description: The heart/favorite icon on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card is white/outline while on the pizza promo card below it is dark filled, creating inconsistent icon styling across similar cards.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon color/style across all promotional cards regardless of background image for visual consistency.
